display_name: EU AI Act: when a provider must report a serious incident, to whom, by when, and the fines (Articles 3, 20(2), 51, 52(1), 55(1)(c), 73, 75(1a), 99, 101, 111, 113), as enacted and as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744
method: SOLO. The encoding-a-subject workflow in one session from a pinned brief: coverage table, nouns first, tests from the source, check.sh with a main build, srcrefs.py --refs on every quotation. Then an independent test pass by a separate agent that decided its answers from the sources before opening the encoding (tests-independent-answers-first.md, tests-independent.l4); two rule changes followed from it (NOTES.md, forks F13 and F14). No human gate.
edition_encoded: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 as published in OJ L 12.7.2024 (../../registers/source-bundle/eu-ai-act-2024-1689.txt), and as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, OJ L 24.7.2026, in force 27 July 2026 (../../registers/source-bundle/eu-omnibus-2026-1744.txt). Two vintages, taken as an input by the core rules; the seat module derives the vintage from the date asked about.

scope: Encoded: Art 2(2); Art 3(3), (49), (61); Art 20(2); Art 51(1)-(2); Art 52(1) (with 52(2)-(4) as inputs); Art 55(1)(c); Art 73(1)-(6), (8)-(10); Art 75(1) and (1a) as inserted by 2026/1744; Art 75c(4) as inserted; Art 99(1), (4), (6), (6a as inserted); Art 101(1)(a); Art 111(2), (3); Art 113; 2026/1744 Art 4. Inert: Art 26(5), Art 51(3), Art 99(7). Deferred: Art 75c(5), Art 99(5). Out of scope: classification as high-risk (Art 6, Annexes I and III, taken as an input), conformity assessment and the high-risk requirements generally, Art 50 (in comparative/ai-content-labelling), governance machinery (Arts 75(1b)-(2a), 75a, 75b, 75d), codes of practice (Art 55(2)), official-only duties (Art 73(7), (11)). The coverage table in NOTES.md lists every row.
